2.5.1.6-f1.text: ℞. diacodii ℥ i dioscordii ʒ ß aquae lactucae ℥ iii ß / mista fiat potio ad horam somni sumenda.

translations.literal: Take of diacodium ounce 1, of dioscordium drachm half, of water of lettuce ounces 3 and a half / mixed let there be made a potion to be taken at the hour of sleep.
translations.note: Diacodium is a syrup of poppy heads; 'dioscordium' is diascordium, an opiate electuary named after scordium (water germander). Prose recipe set out as two lines in the text.
translations.text: Take of diacodium 1 ounce, of diascordium half a drachm, of lettuce water 3½ ounces; / mix, and let a draught be made, to be taken at bedtime.

translations.note: Diacodium is a syrup of poppy heads; dioscordium is Burton's spelling of diascordium, an electuary containing scordium (water germander). Quantities: ℥ i = 1 ounce, ʒ ß = half a drachm, ℥ iii ß = three and a half ounces.
translations.text: Take diacodium 1 ounce, diascordium ½ drachm, lettuce water 3½ ounces; mixed, let a draught be made, to be taken at the hour of sleep.

2.5.1.6-f22.text: ℞. Nucleorum per sic. seminis melonum ana ℥ ß / aquae fragorum ll. ii misce, utatur mane.

translations.literal: Take of kernels of peach, of seed of melons, of each ounce half / of water of strawberries ll. 2, mix, let him use it in the morning.
translations.note: 'per sic.' is read as persicorum (peach), the usual 'nuclei persicorum' of recipes, though the abbreviation is odd. 'll.' is kept as written: it most likely stands for librae (pounds), but this is not certain.
translations.text: Take of peach kernels and of melon seed, of each half an ounce, / of strawberry water ll. 2; mix; let him take it in the morning.

translations.note: The abbreviation "per sic." is unclear; it is probably a corruption of "persic.", meaning peach kernels (nucleorum persicorum), but it is kept as written. "ll." is read as libras (pounds). "ana ℥ ß" means half an ounce of each.
translations.text: Take kernels of per sic. and melon seeds, of each half an ounce; strawberry water 2 pounds; mix, and let him use it in the morning.
